notes: Smart Split now auto-checks whether each person has the app when you tap Create, so in-app payment notifications work without a manual check. Family Sharing now has a back-to-Finance button on every tab, not just Home. Family member names and photos now show whatever you set in your own Profile, and stay in sync if you change them later. The AI Assistant now remembers your last few messages instead of forgetting after every reply. Goals can now be set to any custom date, not just 1 or 3 months.
